interpretation.code_definition: code/family identity and stabilizer/CSS validity are explicit obligations
interpretation.distance: distance/certificate evidence supports only the declared distance proposition
interpretation.syndrome_extraction: circuit semantics is a distinct obligation from distance
interpretation.noise_model: physical/error model is explicit proposition data
interpretation.decoder: decoder contract and implementation evidence are distinct from code distance
interpretation.correction: correction relation and logical-state preservation are explicit obligations
interpretation.rounds: finite repeated-round claims bind exact round/noise/code universe

notes: Prevents a distance certificate or finite Stim/PyMatching run from silently implying end-to-end or all-code QEC correctness.
